title: 去超市

explanations.1: 星期日 indicates the day of the week; Sunday sets the time.
explanations.2: 早上 means morning, specifying the time of day.
explanations.3: 一起 means together, emphasizing joint action with mother.
explanations.4: 超市 is the destination; it refers to the supermarket.
explanations.5: 问 means to ask; introduces the question about what to buy.
explanations.6: 什么 is an interrogative pronoun used to ask about things.
explanations.7: 说 means to say; introduces the response to the question.
explanations.8: 水果 is a noun meaning fruit, one of the items bought.
explanations.9: 在 is a preposition indicating location; here it means 'at'.
explanations.10: 的 is a possessive particle showing relation between 'home' and 'right side'.
explanations.11: 右边 means right side, a direction word indicating location.
explanations.12: 许多 means many, quantifier for the things bought.
explanations.13: 苹果 is a specific fruit; it is one of the items purchased.
explanations.14: 还 means also; indicates an additional purchase.
explanations.15: 鱼 is a noun meaning fish, another item bought.
explanations.16: 喜欢 means to like; expresses preference for drinking red tea.
explanations.17: 五 is the number five, indicating the quantity of bottles.
explanations.18: 瓶 is a measure word for bottled drinks.
explanations.19: 会 is an auxiliary verb meaning 'can' or 'know how to', indicating ability to cook.
explanations.20: 就 is an adverb meaning 'then', linking the time and action.

translation: On Sunday morning, I went to the supermarket with my mother. Mother asked me what I wanted to buy. I said I wanted to buy fruit and milk. The supermarket is on the right side of our home. We bought many things. There were apples, milk, and bread. Mother also bought fish and meat. I like to drink red tea. We bought five bottles of red tea. At noon, we went home to cook. Mother can cook; it is delicious. In the afternoon, a friend came to my home to play. We watched a movie together. In the evening, I was very tired, so I went to sleep at ten o'clock.
